text_block_list.text:
One day after school,
I saw Duramente call 
out to Satono Crown.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Crown. In today's training... it looked 
like you had far too much strength left 
over.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Did you make a mistake designing your 
menu? ...That's unlike you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Ahaha, jeez. You see right through 
everything, Duramente-san.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Well, but... no, I'm fine. I just made a 
misstep and got a little down,
that's all! 
By tomorrow, I'll be right back to my 
usual self.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Once, after losing a mock race, I lost 
my composure too.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
What "crystal of great lineage"? Ashamed 
of my weakness, I lost sight of myself... 
and trained blindly without direction.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...? Yes... I remember. You were pushing 
yourself to an extraordinary degree...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Haa... haa...! Damn it—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's some high-intensity training! But 
it won't be very effective, you know?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...What did you say?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I know a special training routine that's 
much more effective! How about joining me 
this weekend?
I guarantee you won't regret 
it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now then! Duramente-san... let's have a 
ball juggling match!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Wait. You were supposed to be inviting 
me to train.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, now, now! Let's get started right 
away. Of course, no holding back allowed!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(What am I doing, ? This is no time to be 
doing this...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Is it really fine to be so distracted? At 
this rate, I'm going to win this match!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I lost! And it was such a good match,
too! 
...Then again,
it turned out just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san 
watches soccer matches quite often,
doesn't she? 
I bet she's really good at this kind of
thing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Your ball juggling was quite precise,
too. 
With more practice,
your record will definitely improve.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Really? 
Then show me how it's done again. 
I'm gonna figure out the trick to your
juggling!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...When Duramente-san juggles the ball, 
it barely has any spin on it. 
Could that be a hint...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Sharp. You've got a keen eye.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
ï¼â¦â¦Strange. Before I knew it,
my body felt so lightââï¼

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I think I'm starting to get the hang of
it!
I feel like I can do it right next time!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Then you're next. I'll count the reps.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe I got such a huge combo!
Hou yeh! 
New record♪

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Crown. My thanks to you. 
Starting tomorrow,
I feel I can devote myself to training.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! ...Hehe, that's more like it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to competing... 
against you at your very best.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Gladly. 
I'll face you with running worthy of the
'strongest'.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...In other words.
What I'm trying to say is—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Are you free on your next day off?
...There's a board game café I'd like to
show you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ! Ahaha, honestly... I'm no match for you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
with pleasure! I'll make a full recovery, 
and show you I can compete with you again!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Now that's the spirit.
